gloss: to start over; to come back again

definitions.gloss: to start over; to make a fresh start; to try again
definitions.explanation: To begin something again from the beginning, often after a failed attempt.

definitions.gloss: to come back again; to return at a better time
definitions.explanation: To leave and return later, usually when the timing wasn't right the first time.

examples.japanese: {人生|じんせい}を{出直|でなお}したい。
examples.english: I want to start my life over.

examples.japanese: {失敗|しっぱい}したので{最初|さいしょ}から{出直|でなお}すことにした。
examples.english: Since I failed, I decided to start over from the beginning.

examples.japanese: {計画|けいかく}がうまくいかなかったので、ゼロから{出直|でなお}そう。
examples.english: The plan didn't work out, so let's start over from zero.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}を{辞|や}めて、{新|あたら}しい{気持|きも}ちで{出直|でなお}すつもりだ。
examples.english: I plan to quit the company and make a fresh start with a new attitude.

examples.japanese: また{出直|でなお}します。
examples.notes: Polite expression used when leaving to return later

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}が{留守|るす}だったので{出直|でなお}した。
examples.english: The person was out, so I came back later.

examples.japanese: {店|みせ}が{混|こ}んでいたので、{時間|じかん}を{変|か}えて{出直|でなお}した。
examples.english: The store was crowded, so I changed the time and came back.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{忙|いそが}しいので、{明日|あした}{出直|でなお}してもいいですか。
examples.english: I'm busy today, so may I come back tomorrow?

examples.japanese: {担当者|たんとうしゃ}が{不在|ふざい}だったので、{午後|ごご}に{出直|でなお}すことにした。
examples.english: The person in charge was absent, so I decided to come back in the afternoon.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Compound verb: {出|で}る + {直|なお}す.

NUANCE: The {直|なお}す component suggests "doing over" or "redoing." This verb implies going back to the beginning and trying again with a fresh approach.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・ゼロから{出直|でなお}す: to start over from zero
・{一|いち}から{出直|でなお}す: to start over from scratch
・また{出直|でなお}します: I'll come back again (polite)

SIMILAR:
・やり{直|なお}す: to redo, to do over (more general)
